text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 — elevated 5xx rate for inference-api in prod-us-east-1 following deploy. Initial symptom: KMS Decrypt failures in auth layer. Paging oncall.

maya: I'm up, joining. What do we know so far?

rick (oncall): seeing a ton of errors like:
```
2026-03-15T12:11:03Z ERROR auth-proxy: KMS AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::555555:assumed-role/inference-exec-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555555:key/rot-2026-03-15
```
Canary traffic is ~35% to revision `inference:v2026-03-15`. Canary started at 12:00 UTC.

jo (deploy): I kicked off the deploy at 11:59 which included a key rotation (alias `alias/redwood-rot-0315`) and enabling `new_kms` feature flag. Rotation used `tools/kms-rotate --alias redwood-rot-0315` from the release job; we expected key policy/grants to be preserved.

tina (sre): symptoms point to the new CMK not granting decrypt to the runtime role. Fast mitigations: a) flip feature flag off, b) reduce canary to zero, c) revoke alias switching (if possible) or d) create an emergency grant for decrypt. Which is fastest?

infra-bot: feature flag flip request received from tina.

jo (deploy): flipping flag now: `featurectl set new_kms false` -> OK. Scaling canary to 0: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-canary -n prod-us-east --replicas=0`.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by jo. Rolling inference service: v2026-03-15 -> v2026-03-14.

rick (oncall): error rate dropping but still seeing errors from sessions minted during the 11:59–12:02 window — those session tokens are encrypted with the new key and fail decrypt.

maya: instead of editing the key policy, can we create a temporary KMS grant for the role? Grants are scoped and auto-expire.

tina (sre): good plan. Creating grant now with 1 hour validity. Command: `aws kms create-grant --key-id rot-2026-03-15 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::555555:role/inference-exec-role --operations Decrypt --name emergency-decrypt-grant-2055` -> GrantId: g-1c2d3e.

rick (oncall): after grant creation + rollback + cache invalidation at the gateway, errors are back to baseline. Metrics: 12:05 UTC 4.8% -> 12:18 UTC 0.04%.

jo (deploy): digging into rotation helper logs: the rotate tool created a fresh CMK and moved the alias but did not copy existing grants nor the policy statement that allowed the inference role to decrypt. The helper has an opt-in flag `--copy-grants` which the release job did not pass. That's the bug.

maya: also found a manifest mismatch: the release manifest used `new-kms` instead of `new_kms`, so the automated rollback guard didn't catch the issue during canary promotion. Two separate causes combined.

infra-bot: triggered cache purge on edge: `POST /internal/cache/purge {prefix: "sess_enc_"}` -> 202 Accepted.

rick (oncall): residual failures frame: ~18 minutes of elevated errors, approx 1.9k failed requests, three enterprise customers experienced degraded responses. No evidence of data compromise; decrypt fail is pre-runtime.

jo (deploy): I'm opening immediate follow-ups: PR to make rotate helper always copy policies/grants unless explicitly opted-out; add an integration smoke test that performs kms:Decrypt as the inference role before alias switch; add a manifest linter rule to enforce flag naming conventions.

tina (sre): I'll document the emergency grant lifecycle and ensure it is revoked after expiry. Also adding a runbook step: always validate grants/policy after rotation and before traffic shift.

maya: please prepare timeline and SLA impact calc. PD bot, make sure incident is acknowledged and create PD incident for postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged. Reminder: attach timeline and update oncall handoff notes in PD.

deploy-bot: rollback completed and verified. Canary scaled down.

incident-bot: incident marked resolved :white_check_mark:. Will schedule postmortem with participants.

maya: handing off to lee (next oncall). Summary: KMS key rotation omitted copying grants/policy; manifest flag name mismatch prevented automated kill-switch; mitigations: flag flip, canary scale down, rollback, temporary KMS grant, cache purge. Action owners: jo (rotate tool PR + smoke tests), tina (grant lifecycle + runbook), rick (incident timeline + SLA numbers). Postmortem planned for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.

rick (oncall): handoff complete.
